secrets.name: BOOTSTRAP_PLATFORM_ADMIN_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Password for the first-run platform_admin account created by migration 001. A dev default is in .env.base44-defaults; set a real one to control the admin login.

secrets.name: JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: JWT signing secret for session tokens. A dev default is in .env.base44-defaults; set a real long random value for any non-dev use.

secrets.name: SSO_CONFIG_ENCRYPTION_KEY
secrets.description: Encryption key for stored SSO/IdP config. A dev default is in .env.base44-defaults.

secrets.name: SMTP_PASS
secrets.description: SMTP password for outbound email (apps/mims email poller). Optional — the app boots and runs without it; email features stay disabled until a real value is provided.
